answer: To enter, an applicant must publish a cipher of a secret and pay a nonrefundable reservation fee before the epoch's comet beacon reveals public randomness. After opening, the secret is hashed onto a fixed ring and is admitted only if it is the unique closest unoccupied vertex; every losing or unopened reservation is burned. A Sybil who wants many identities has to pre-commit that many times, burning fees on misses and locking a slashable bond on each winning vertex, so fake accounts cannot be ground after the beacon and scale linearly in capital.
